Summary.Title: Platform Ownership and Boundary Map
Summary.PlatformB1DecisionBoundary: ADVANCED ASSURANCE EVALUATION ONLY; NO INDEPENDENT REGULATED EXECUTION OR BINDING AUTHORITY
Summary.SourceOfTruthRule: Official records remain in governed source systems.
Summary.HumanAccountabilityRule: Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles remain accountable.
Summary.Step150Statement: Step 150 maps ownership, authority, dependencies, and boundaries. It does not implement capabilities, change architecture, deploy services, validate production systems, or authorize regulated execution.

LayerMap.PrimaryOwner: Platform A governance and discovery layer
LayerMap.DisplayWitnessRole: May display inventory, discovery, and governance context
LayerMap.PermittedScope: Discover, register, inventory, classify, contextualize, and route regulated AI and assurance use cases.
LayerMap.ProhibitedScope: Must not approve, release, override, execute, or bind regulated work.
LayerMap.InboundDependencies: Use-case sponsors, governance owners, source-system metadata, and organizational context.
LayerMap.OutboundDependencies: Provides governed context to Platform B, Platform B1, and Thread C.

LayerMap.PrimaryOwner: Platform B v1 assurance decision engine
LayerMap.AssuranceDecisionRole: Evaluates assurance state and action admissibility within the frozen six-capability core.
LayerMap.DisplayWitnessRole: Produces assurance state consumed by Thread D v1.
LayerMap.BindingAuthority: ASSURANCE EVALUATION ONLY; HUMAN AUTHORITY REMAINS REQUIRED
LayerMap.OfficialRecordAuthority: DOES NOT REPLACE OFFICIAL SOURCE-SYSTEM RECORDS
LayerMap.PermittedScope: AI Use Case Registry; Assurance Check API; Evidence Upload; Operational Trust Score; Action Admissibility Record; Wearable Endpoint Simulator.
LayerMap.ProhibitedScope: Must not reopen architecture, add unapproved core capabilities, replace the Quality Unit, or release work.
LayerMap.InboundDependencies: Governed evidence, Platform A context, human-defined controls, and official source-system references.
LayerMap.OutboundDependencies: Provides locked-core assurance state to Thread D v1 and supports bounded Platform B1 evolution.

LayerMap.PrimaryOwner: Platform B1 / MVP2 advanced assurance layer
LayerMap.AssuranceDecisionRole: Evaluates advanced assurance, evidence integrity, workflow dependency, authority, and No-Bind conditions.
LayerMap.DisplayWitnessRole: Produces advanced assurance signals consumed by Thread D2.
LayerMap.BindingAuthority: ASSURANCE EVALUATION ONLY; HUMAN AUTHORITY REMAINS REQUIRED
LayerMap.OfficialRecordAuthority: DOES NOT REPLACE LIS, MES, EQUALITY, SERVICENOW, ERP, CLINICAL, OR OTHER OFFICIAL SOURCE SYSTEMS
LayerMap.PermittedScope: Implement and evaluate advanced assurance logic using simulator-first, mock-data-first, and local-validation-first controls.
LayerMap.ProhibitedScope: Must not modify Platform B v1, approve GMP work, release results, override source systems, or become evidence authority.
LayerMap.InboundDependencies: Platform A context, Platform B core state, governed evidence, source-system references, identity, authority, and control rules.
LayerMap.OutboundDependencies: Provides evaluated advanced assurance state to Thread D2 and validated concepts to Thread C.
LayerMap.ArchitectureBoundary: Advanced assurance layer surrounding, but not reopening, Platform B v1.

LayerMap.PrimaryOwner: Thread C / AEBOK doctrine and publication layer
LayerMap.DisplayWitnessRole: May communicate models, principles, case studies, and validated lessons.
LayerMap.OfficialRecordAuthority: PUBLICATION OUTPUTS ARE NOT OFFICIAL REGULATED RECORDS
LayerMap.PermittedScope: Document, teach, publish, research, and translate Assurance Engineering doctrine and architecture.
LayerMap.ProhibitedScope: Must not execute regulated actions or represent concepts as implemented without evidence.
LayerMap.InboundDependencies: Validated lessons and controlled outputs from Platforms A, B, B1, Thread D, and Thread D2.
LayerMap.OutboundDependencies: Supports PhD research, publications, books, regulatory engagement, and architecture doctrine.

LayerMap.DisplayWitnessRole: DISPLAY / WITNESS ONLY for Platform B v1 assurance state.
LayerMap.BindingAuthority: NO APPROVAL, RELEASE, OR OVERRIDE AUTHORITY
LayerMap.OfficialRecordAuthority: NOT A SOURCE SYSTEM AND NOT EVIDENCE AUTHORITY
LayerMap.PermittedScope: Display or witness Platform B v1 assurance state through the validated connector.
LayerMap.ProhibitedScope: Must not decide, approve, release, override, execute, or become the official record.
LayerMap.InboundDependencies: Validated Platform B v1 connector and assurance outputs.
LayerMap.OutboundDependencies: Context display to authorized users or wearable simulators.
LayerMap.ArchitectureBoundary: Closed Platform B v1 display and context-witness boundary.

LayerMap.PrimaryOwner: Thread D2 / RAMAT Vision advanced display layer
LayerMap.DisplayWitnessRole: DISPLAY / WITNESS ONLY for Platform B1 evaluated state.
LayerMap.BindingAuthority: NO APPROVAL, RELEASE, OR OVERRIDE AUTHORITY
LayerMap.OfficialRecordAuthority: NOT A SOURCE SYSTEM AND NOT EVIDENCE AUTHORITY
LayerMap.PermittedScope: Display advanced assurance, No-Bind, inspection readiness, evidence integrity, dependency, and governance states.
LayerMap.ProhibitedScope: Must not approve, resolve governance holds, release work, execute actions, replace source systems, or bind decisions.
LayerMap.InboundDependencies: Platform B1 assurance signals, governed display contracts, and simulator-safe context.
LayerMap.OutboundDependencies: Preview-only visual states for RAMAT Vision, glasses, wearables, and authorized displays.
